title: Sand & Polish quote, real prices, under a minute
jobDescription: About 65m² of existing tongue-and-groove pine floor through living and hallway. Heavy sand to bare timber, 3 coats water-based satin polyurethane. Keep natural timber colour.
workingDetail: Floor polish/varnish, Sandpaper (various grits), Wood filler, Drop sheets

conversation.request: Hey Mate, can you whip up a quote for a floor sand and polish? It's for about sixty-five square metres of pine, living and hallway, heavy sand, three coats water-based satin poly, natural colour.
conversation.mateAck: Good one. I'll sort a Sand & Polish quote for you now.
conversation.clarifyingQuestion: Righto — just so I'm spot on, what's the existing finish on the floor, and can you confirm the floor area is exactly sixty-five square metres?
conversation.clarifyingAnswer: Yeah, it's old varnish, and sixty-five square metres on the dot.
conversation.matePricing: Sweet — pricing it up now with live supplier rates…
conversation.reveal: Here's the quote — for sixty-five square metres of heavy sand on pine, three coats of water-based satin poly, keeping the natural timber colour.

presenter.reaction: That's the lot — real prices and everything. Sorted.
presenter.setting: A wide shot of a sunlit living room with an unfinished pine floor, showing a tradie standing centrally with a tablet.
